composition_rule: The Goal Task consumes only the reusable components required for the remaining standard KV evidence path. Premium automated/scheduled provider publication remains the separate SS-KV-SKAP-SOCIAL-RELEASE-001 Goal Task and therefore does not force Publisher, SDK return, StegVerse final egress, or far-side-final components into this task.

RTC-ROUNDTRIP-003.input: canonical StegSocials preparation bundle plus intended personal-KV draft path and exact content bytes
RTC-ROUNDTRIP-003.output: KV admission plus exact stored-byte readback bound to path/hash/size
RTC-ROUNDTRIP-003.repeatability: ONE_REQUIRED_STANDARD_KV_SAVE_READBACK_CYCLE; retry only after classified failure without upgrading evidence

RTC-EVIDENCE-CUSTODY-004.input: verified standard-flow evidence object and existing ERL/provider receipt chain references
RTC-EVIDENCE-CUSTODY-004.output: retained evidence/readback/reconstruction references without publication or device-identity inference
RTC-EVIDENCE-CUSTODY-004.repeatability: per independently custodial evidence object; historical custody evidence is reused and not replayed

RTC-INTERLOCK-INTR-TRANSPORT-008.output: governed admission/transport receipt for the exact transition
RTC-INTERLOCK-INTR-TRANSPORT-008.repeatability: repeat only for distinct governed transitions; prior receipt never authorizes a later transition

non_transport_reuse.user_verification: KV/SKAP Vault existing authority; not a reusable transport component
non_transport_reuse.custody_reconstruction: master-records/orchestration existing ERL/StegSocials custody and reconstruction implementations
non_transport_reuse.runtime_observation: existing canonical runtime/transport observation owners; no new runtime observer
non_transport_reuse.credential_session: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_STANDARD_MANUAL_LANE; TV/TVC remains owner for separate provider/release work
